description:
Initialization only: Permutation Genetic Algorithm.
- Population: Up to 8 chromosomes (seeded by ascending ID order and random shuffles).
- Operators: 2-way tournament selection and one elite per generation; copy a contiguous segment from the first parent, then fill remaining positions left to right in second-parent order; apply random swap mutation with probability 0.25.
- Termination: Stop at evaluation limit (or if <2 tasks); return best issued trial.
